title: ps5-linux-loader belongs on your radar
description:
This repo should be on your radar: ps5-linux/ps5-linux-loader. Linux payload implementing the HV exploit and a custom bootloader. It has about 1,380 GitHub stars, and it is active enough to deserve a closer look. Save this for your next build, and follow for more useful developer tools.

https://github.com/ps5-linux/ps5-linux-loader
